visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a massive black banner hanging from a silver metal truss structure. Two cartoon characters, a spotted cow and a turtle with a leopard-print shell, are centered on the banner. Bright blue and yellow animated text flashes across the lower screen. In the blurred background, people wander through a large, well-lit exhibition hall with high white ceilings and industrial fixtures. (2) A sharp transition reveals an extreme close-up of a prehistoric-looking iguana with rough, scaly grey skin and a piercing purple eye. The lighting is focused and cinematic. This is followed by a shot of clear plastic reptile tubs filled with white substrate and small geckos, neatly arranged on a table. (3) The camera pans across a dense crowd of attendees in a convention center. A person in a high-fidelity T-Rex animatronic costume leans down to interact with a group of children and adults who are reaching out to touch its snout. The hall is filled with banners, booths, and overhead lighting. (4) Multiple quick cuts showcase exotic animals: a person holding a small brown lizard, a young woman with bright pink hair and a white mask cradling a large brown monitor lizard, and a hawk with spread wings perched on a thick leather falconry glove. Each shot is a medium close-up focusing on the texture of the animals. (5) The scene shifts to rows of reptiles in display tanks. A white-shelled turtle with black spots swims in a glass aquarium. A man wearing glasses and a green cap holds a large red tegu lizard against his shoulder; the lizard flickers its forked pink tongue toward the camera. The background shows a bustling crowd. (6) Visual focus moves to food stalls within the venue, displaying pastries and scones under glass cases with handwritten labels. A person in a full-body turtle mascot suit with leopard spots walks through the hall, waving at attendees. The editing is fast-paced, with dynamic transitions between shots of food, games, and animals. (7) The final phase features complex graphic overlays showing a pink-haired girl riding a giant horned toad. An aerial map view zooms in on the Taichung International Exhibition Center, showing nearby highways and a river. Close-ups of a veiled chameleon and a stick insect appear briefly before the screen fills with the colorful event logo and dates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The master track opens with a high-energy male narrator delivering Mandarin speech at a rapid rate and high pitch. Simultaneously, a bright, synth-heavy electronic BGM kicks in with a strong 128 BPM beat. A crisp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the end of the opening graphic phase. (2) As the close-up of the lizard appears, a subtle 'ding' SFX resonates in the high frequency range. The narrator's tone is extremely animated and enthusiastic. The music maintains a constant spectral energy without any bass drops. Ambient indoor hall resonance is barely perceptible behind the clear vocal. (3) A sharp 'pop' sound effect triggers with the appearance of the 'cannot miss' variety text. The BGM remains dominant in the background, with a prominent snare drum texture. The narrator's voice shows high emotional arousal and dynamic pitch variability, typical of promotional content. (4) Multiple fast edits are punctuated by rhythmic 'swoosh' and digital 'blip' SFX. The narrator's articulation remains sharp and clear. Faint crowd murmurs and occasional short-duration thuds are audible but heavily ducked under the primary vocal and music track. (5) As the narrator discusses the tegu lizard, the BGM complexity increases with added melodic synth patterns. A percussive 'click' SFX accompanies the scene transition. The harmonic clarity is high, with the vocal sitting perfectly above the music in the mix. (6) A cheerful 'chime' SFX plays during the food segment, adding to the festive atmosphere. The narrator's volume increases for key phrases like 'big feast.' The BGM beat remains unwavering, providing a rhythmic anchor for the high-frequency vocal delivery. (7) The finale features a 'riser' SFX that builds tension before the final event dates are announced. A solid 'impact' SFX coincides with the logo reveal. The audio fades out quickly with a final 'ding' chime, leaving a clean tail. The production quality is consistent with professional social media marketing standards.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Sensory Experience (Sight/Touch/Taste) -> Operational Info (Date/Location) -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the 2026 Taiwan Reptile Festival. By blending vlog-style animal encounters with traditional event highlights like crowds, games, and food, it aims to create an inviting and exciting image of the festival to attract both reptile enthusiasts and general families for the upcoming ticket sales in December.
